notes: v579 — YOUR SERVER STORE IS NOW THE MAIN ROAD. Until now the whole-day fill (v578) was a button you had to remember; the everyday download still went share by share. Now, before any download, the app samples its own saved history: if coverage is thin it fills straight from your server store automatically — one request per trading DAY (about 4,300 bars each) — and if coverage is deep it just tops up the newest days. The per-share pass afterwards only fetches what the store genuinely lacks. Also fixed: the loading status line could name free public relays that were retired from this path back in v474 — route names now tell the truth (your Cloudflare server, or direct EODData), and two dead route attempts that each first fetch tripped over are gone. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5); the first download after this may pause briefly while it fills by day — that pause replaces thousands of per-share requests.
